parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used to start the next query. To retrieve the next page of results, set this parameter to the NextToken value from the previous response.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region to which the resource belongs.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

- ContainerGroup: an ECI instance

- ImageCache: an image cache

- DataCache: a data cache

- VirtualNode: a virtual node
